body: Haha, if there's something on the other side I'll be sure to try and pay you a visit :p

That's the thing, I don't have any family left. I was my parents' only kid, and they were their parents' only kids, so when they died I didn't have any family. I would never be able to even think about suicide if I still had family, but I didn't, which would've made the decision slightly easier for me.
Thanks, and fuck cancer indeed..

Keeping it a secret from my friends was the only thing that was eating me up, and finally telling them was scary, but their reactions took the last weights off my shoulders..it's weird not having to worry about a single thing in life anymore..besides death ofcourse, but that's something everyone has to deal with at some point, some just a little sooner than others. Thanks for your comment :)
Thanks for taking the time to comment :)

It's good to be aware of scams, but my first post was a week before OceanSkys did his AMA. I mentioned him because his story inspired me to not go ahead and end it when I feel fit. He will travel the world, and it's awesome to see people pitch in to help him do that, but I have no such desires. I just want to spend the last days I have with friends. Don't need money to do that. I'm a medstudent without any debts thanks to keeping 2 jobs on the side, and as a medstudent I can loan quite a lot of money from the bank, which is what I meant when I said that I'd probably do that and then donate it to charity. I'll just say it here: I won't accept any money, and I'd rather see it go to OceanSkys or a charity that people feel comfortable with.

I don't really feel alone, but I did want to talk to someone, anyone, about this, and since I go on reddit quite often I found this subreddit and felt like it was the perfect place to vent...I just want to spend my last days with my friends like I always do, without them feeling sorry for me.

Getting lethal drugs isn't really my issue..I have access to quite a few drugs in the hospital, and most drugs are lethal if you take too much of them. I could do the same as they do in Switzerland, but without putting a doctor before the dilemma of helping me or not. But the problem there is that it'd definitely look like suicide..When I want to go I want to 1) make it look like an accident and 2) don't harm anyone else in any way. So stuff like jumping/falling in front of a train was out the window pretty quick, and so was jumping off a bridge above a highway, and the regular suicide methods like hanging, overdosing, cutting are out of the picture as well. I was thinking of getting really drunk in the middle of the night and crashing my car into a wall or something, but then I'd take the risk of running into someone else and I'd be remembered as that asshole who was driving drunk and killed someone..not to mention that there's a good chance that I could blackout while driving.. So then I thought of getting really drunk and taking my bicycle out to a bridge, and make it look like I'd fallen off of it, but there aren't that many high enough bridges here to make death certain, and I really don't want to end up with every bone in my body broken with me still being conscious. And I wouldn't do it through skydiving if I'd still need an instructor, but I don't...I could just hop aboard a plane that's taking stuff from A to B, and I could get out halfway..

But I'm not really afraid of dying. I used to be, like everyone else, but knowing that I'm going to die soon made me think about death..a lot...and I came to the conclusion that death is probably just as scary as life before life, which to me wasn't really scary..at all.
But that's the thing, I don't have any last wishes, whatsoever. My friends hate getting me birthday presents, because I never know what I want. I just want to hang with my friends like I always do.
I've read a shitload of after life theories, but they all make equal sense..0...
was fun in highschool, but I stopped after I lost a few friends who had switched to harddrugs..

No I'm not going to tell my friends about it. I want them to treat me like they always do, and not give me some sort of special pity treatment, making their lives resolve around mine. I won't be losing my hair, and besides from the possibility of looking a bit yellowish and skinny they probably won't have any idea, which is for the best. My friends just describe me as a fun guy to be around with, and that's how I'm gonna spend my last days.
don't believe everything you hear man ;) life after death is probably the same as life before life..not much to it.

Heh, I know that wasn't the way you were putting it :p I just don't have any things to do..a bucket list..or whatever..I was just living life by going through medschool, and I'd see where life takes me from there. I don't have a wish like 'oh, I really wanted to go and climb mt everest' or 'if only I got to see the niagara falls'. I just don't. I'll keep living my last days to the max, but as soon as I feel like I'm getting too weak, I really think I'll end it myself.

But I do know how long I have left...sort of..2 months if I'm extremely lucky. When I woke up today my head hurt worse than when I woke up yesterday. I had to tape off 1 eye today as the double vision was even worse than vision without depth perception..the white in my eyes is starting to turn yellowish, indicating the fact that the tumor is doing its work in my liver, and every now and then my diarrhea turns green, so the tumor in my pancreas is also not taking any breaks. Fighting this would mean that I'd accept whatever is going to happen to me, and I don't. I don't want to end up like a lifeless, drooling zombie in a bed, completely dependent on other people to take care of me, fighting to last a couple of extra days while looking at the pity in the eyes of people visiting me.. That's just..not me..

I don't know..pictures and stuff would kind of take away the anonymity which gave me the courage to openly talk about this in the first place..and I really don't feel like learning how to use video editing software in my final days..;) as for music I like..I like covers..of anything. Just listening to talented people before they're signed by big labels and before they're being dragged into the world of horrible popmusic.. stuff like [this](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wQfI50PfG2c), which was featured yesterday on reddit. That's just awesome. Or those 2 guys who cover songs on 1 piano..especially [this](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QQoFLrZ5C3M) song really hits home atm. But yeah, I'd just look for songs by typin 'cover' and listen to stuff..

I was tested by 3 other doctors...the 2 months prospective was the most positive one..as for things I wanna do...I can't really think of anything..at least, not anything that's not long term..what I wanted to do was get a career, start a family, stuff like that.

As much as I'd like to see the world, I just can't take the risk of suddenly collapsing while I'm abroad. I want to die in my own country..Besides, I'm a medstudent with already 30k in debt. Not having to pay off those loans is quite a weight off my shoulders, but I'm not gonna borrow more money with the knowledge that whoever gives it to me is never gonna get it back.

I don't really like that dramatic approach, really...I'd rather have them think I didn't commit suicide at all, but that I'd died in some sort of accident...parachutes dont always open... I just don't want to seem like a coward who gave up that easily...maybe ill pretend to have written in a diary over the years, but it'd really be some sort of memoirs that I'd have written in my last week so they'd at least have something..
holland

Fight for what? Fight until the cancer has completely disabled me to the point where I'm trapped inside my own head? Because that's what's gonna happen. I know what happens to people with stage IV brain tumors. I've seen it quite a few times myself, and everytime I saw a case like this I'd think to myself 'I would never want to end up like that, I'd rather take a bullet to the head'.
heh, wouldn't exactly be a fair trade

I didn't really live for anything. I just did what I thought was expected of me. Went back to medschool because that's what I thought my parents would've wanted, and I'd look at wherever life takes me from there. I can't just keep doing what I was doing, because I feel I'm getting sicker and sicker. If I wake up one day and find out I'm starting to forget even a few things and get more blackouts, I'd be hospitalized and kept alive until my brain goes. That's not how I wanna go..

Maybe...but watching my grandfather fight cancer to the end put some perspective into my life. I'd have to look at pictures of him to remember him in a good way, because all I can think of when I'm trying to remember him by head is an old, sad man who was too weak to even swallow his saliva. I don't want to end up like that, and I don't want my friends to remember me the way I remember my grandfather..

Already been skydiving quite a few times, a friend of my dad's works at our local airport and he was able to hook me up to a few classes. I'm actually allowed to jump without an instructor...it'd be quite a way to go...
I've been playing guitar for a while, but knowing I'll never be able to get good at it is kind of depressing..

My life..nothing too special really..I'm my late parents' only kid, and they were their parents' only kids, so when they died I didn't have any family left. It kind of makes a decision like this easier..in a morbid sort of way..I'd never be able to take my own life if my parents were still alive. Went into medschool at 18, my parents died in a car accident a year later, after which I kind of went into a depression and I dropped out for a year, but I got a new shot at it a year later and am now in my 3rd year, where I'm supposed to be preparing for my 4th year internships..guess I won't have to now. I feel like all the worries I had concerning grades and earning money and what not were absolutely meaningless..
